description.value: Mountain View Cabins is a remote, rustic cabin retreat nestled in the Blaeberry Valley about 20 minutes northwest of Golden, BC, surrounded by Rocky Mountain and Selkirk Mountain scenery. The property offers individual cabins (each with two queen beds, heater, and private washroom) as well as budget 'bunkies' with glamping-style amenities including shared kitchen access, BBQs, and a communal fire pit. Guests are encouraged to unplug and enjoy the natural setting, with a viewpoint trail and campfire area on site.
